results.title: Yankees place Cody Bellinger on IL, recall Spencer Jones
results.description: PHILADELPHIA — The New York Yankees officially placed left fielder Cody Bellinger on the 10-day injured list on Sunday with a left hamstring strain, and recalled Spencer Jones from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre to take Bellinger’s spot on the roster.
